newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy mini-budget will help 1998 accounts - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy mini-budget will help 1998 accounts - Ciampi.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Monday that the government's planned mini-budget would also have a positive effect on 1998 accounts.
"I think the mini-budget is opportune. We will pass it in the next few weeks, we are waiting for the official state accounts," Ciampi told a news conference.
"We expect the effects of the mini-budget also to be felt in 1998," he said.

Prime Minister Romano Prodi announced last week that Italy was passing a mini-budget, expected to be for up to 15 trillion lire ($9.0 billion), in a bid to be in shape for a European single currency at its planned 1999 start. ($1=1,658 lire) -- Reuter +396 678 2501
